issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify `addGuestStudents(int)` with return type `void`, but the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)` returning `boolean` (`public boolean addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)`). Students following the specification will implement a `void` method, which will not match the reference API (and likely the tests).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Prefer changing the solution to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)` and handle invalid (e.g., negative) inputs without returning a value; alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to require a boolean return type and document what `true/false` means.
